title: Pasqal Completes Business Combination with Bleichroeder Acquisition Corp. II, Begins Trading on Nasdaq - Quantum Computing Report
gist: Neutral-atom quantum computing company Pasqal completed its SPAC merger with Bleichroeder Acquisition Corp. II, began trading on Nasdaq as Pasqal Holding SA (PSQL/PSQLW) on August 28, 2026, with roughly $360 million in cash at closing to fund QPU manufacturing, a fault-tolerant roadmap, and HPC/cloud integration, becoming the latest quantum hardware pure-play to go public via SPAC.

insights.claim: Pasqal completed its previously announced business combination with special purpose acquisition company Bleichroeder Acquisition Corp. II, with the combined entity operating as Pasqal Holding SA and beginning trading on the Nasdaq Stock Market on August 28, 2026 under tickers PSQL (ordinary shares) and PSQLW (warrants).
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Pasqal becomes a publicly tradeable, named pure-play quantum hardware stock (PSQL) on Nasdaq, giving investors direct equity exposure to neutral-atom quantum computing and a new comparable for valuing quantum hardware peers like IonQ, Rigetti, and D-Wave.
insights.locator: Neutral-atom quantum computing provider Pasqal has completed

insights.claim: Bleichroeder shareholders approved the transaction on August 25, 2026, and the deal establishes approximately $360 million in cash available to Pasqal at closing.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: The $360M closing cash figure is the concrete capital base investors should track against Pasqal's stated deployment priorities (manufacturing, R&D, HPC integration) and against the previously reported $2 billion deal valuation for the combination.
insights.quote: the deal establishes approximately $360 million in cash available at closing
insights.locator: $360 Million Capital Foundation for Global Scaling

insights.claim: Advisors on the transaction included Lazard Frères SAS and Orrick, Herrington & Sutcliffe LLP for Pasqal, and Cantor Fitzgerald & Co., Reed Smith LLP, and Cohen & Company Capital Markets for Bleichroeder.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Named advisor roster (Lazard, Cantor Fitzgerald) signals a conventional, well-advised SPAC process rather than a distressed or thinly-banked deal, a light diligence data point on deal quality.

insights.claim: Under CEO Wasiq Bokhari, Pasqal plans to allocate the ~$360M in capital to three priorities: scaling QPU manufacturing and international deployment, advancing its neutral-atom architecture from analog quantum processing toward fault-tolerant quantum computing (FTQC), and deepening HPC/cloud integration.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: The explicit analog-to-fault-tolerant roadmap commitment is a milestone investors can hold Pasqal accountable to; progress (or lack thereof) toward FTQC will be a key differentiator versus superconducting and trapped-ion competitors.
insights.locator: Following the approval of the transaction

insights.claim: Pasqal currently operates seven deployed quantum processing units (QPUs) globally with three additional systems in production, running in standard data center environments and serving over 25 commercial and research applications across energy, finance, and materials science.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Seven live deployed QPUs plus 25+ active applications is a concrete commercial-traction baseline to compare against other public quantum hardware companies' deployment counts at time of going public.
insights.quote: Pasqal currently operates seven deployed QPUs with three additional systems in production
insights.locator: Commercial Footprint and Global Enterprise Adoption

insights.claim: Pasqal's customer and partner ecosystem includes Saudi Aramco, Crédit Agricole CIB, LG Electronics, NVIDIA, and the IBM Quantum Network, spanning energy, finance, electronics, and computing sectors.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: A named, cross-sector enterprise customer list (including Saudi Aramco and NVIDIA) is a concrete commercial validation signal for evaluating Pasqal's revenue pipeline as a newly public company.
insights.locator: Its quantum processors run in standard data center environments

insights.claim: Pasqal was co-founded in 2019 by Alain Aspect, the 2022 Nobel Prize-winning physicist, giving the company a scientific-founder pedigree tied directly to quantum mechanics research recognized at the highest level.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: A Nobel laureate co-founder is a notable credibility/branding asset for Pasqal relative to other quantum hardware public listings, relevant to market perception and possibly premium valuation multiples.
insights.quote: Co-founded in 2019 by 2022 Nobel Prize-winning physicist Alain Aspect
insights.locator: Commercial Footprint and Global Enterprise Adoption
